+"""
+Safe loading of images whose location a user can set (cut image_path,
+character/style reference URLs, ...).
+
+The backend never makes an HTTP request to such a location. Only two kinds of
+source are accepted:
+
+- ``data:`` URLs, decoded in memory;
+- objects in our own storage, given either as a relative object key
+  (``schema/identifier/file.png``) or as a full URL under ``STORAGE_HOST``.
+  These are read through the storage client, not fetched over HTTP.
+
+Everything else (any other http(s)/ftp/file URL, protocol-relative URLs, keys
+that try to escape with ``..``) is refused and yields ``None``.
+"""
+import base64
+import binascii
+import re
+from typing import Optional
+from urllib.parse import unquote
+
+from app.core.config import settings
+
+_SCHEME_RE = re.compile(r"^[a-zA-Z][a-zA-Z0-9+.\-]*:")
+
+
+def storage_key_for(location: str) -> Optional[str]:
+    """Return the storage object key that ``location`` refers to, or None if
+    it does not point into our storage."""
+    if not location or not isinstance(location, str):
+        return None
+    location = location.strip()
+
+    host = (settings.STORAGE_HOST or "").rstrip("/")
+    if host and location.startswith(host + "/"):
+        key = location[len(host) + 1:]
+        # A full storage URL may carry a query (e.g. cache busters); drop it.
+        key = key.split("?", 1)[0].split("#", 1)[0]
+        key = unquote(key)
+    elif _SCHEME_RE.match(location) or location.startswith("//") or location.startswith("\\\\"):
+        # Some other absolute URL: never ours.
+        return None
+    else:
+        key = location
+
+    if not key or key.startswith("/") or "\\" in key or "\x00" in key:
+        return None
+    if any(c in key for c in "?#"):
+        return None
+    segments = key.split("/")
+    if any(seg in ("", ".", "..") for seg in segments):
+        return None
+    return key
+
+
+def decode_data_url(location: str) -> Optional[bytes]:
+    """Decode a ``data:`` URL; return None if it is not a valid one."""
+    if not location or not location.startswith("data:"):
+        return None
+    try:
+        header, encoded = location.split(",", 1)
+    except ValueError:
+        return None
+    try:
+        if header.endswith(";base64"):
+            return base64.b64decode(encoded, validate=False)
+        return unquote(encoded).encode("latin-1")
+    except (binascii.Error, ValueError, UnicodeEncodeError):
+        return None
+
+
+def load_image_bytes(location: Optional[str]) -> Optional[bytes]:
+    """Load image bytes from a data: URL or our storage. Never requests a URL."""
+    if not location:
+        return None
+    if location.startswith("data:"):
+        return decode_data_url(location)
+
+    key = storage_key_for(location)
+    if key is None:
+        return None
+
+    from app.services.storage import storage
+
+    try:
+        return storage.download_image(key)
+    except Exception:
+        return None

+"""Exports report the cuts they leave out: `missing.txt` in the ZIP and the
+`X-Missing-Cuts` header in both formats."""
+import base64
+import io
+import zipfile
+
+import pytest
+
+from tests.conftest import signup
+from tests.lab_env import PNG
+
+DATA_URL = "data:image/png;base64," + base64.b64encode(PNG).decode()
+NOT_AN_IMAGE = "data:image/png;base64," + base64.b64encode(b"not an image").decode()
+
+
+def put_in_storage(key, data=PNG):
+    from app.services.storage import storage
+
+    storage.client.put_object(storage.bucket_name, key, io.BytesIO(data), len(data))
+
+
+def make_episode(client, h, image_paths):
+    """Creates an episode with one cut per entry (cut numbers 1, 2, ...)."""
+    project = client.post("/api/v1/projects", headers=h, json={"title": "Night Bus", "genres": []}).json()
+    episode = client.post(
+        "/api/v1/episodes", headers=h, json={"title": "Ep One", "project_id": project["id"], "episode_order": 1}
+    )
+    assert episode.status_code == 200, episode.text
+    episode_id = episode.json()["id"]
+    for i, path in enumerate(image_paths, start=1):
+        body = {"episode_id": episode_id, "cut_order": i}
+        if path is not None:
+            body["image_path"] = path
+        r = client.post("/api/v1/cuts", headers=h, json=body)
+        assert r.status_code == 200, r.text
+    return episode_id
+
+
+def export(client, h, episode_id, fmt):
+    return client.post(f"/api/v1/episodes/{episode_id}/export?format={fmt}", headers=h)
+
+
+MIXED = [
+    DATA_URL,                       # 1 ok
+    None,                           # 2 no image yet
+    "http://169.254.169.254/x.png", # 3 refused address
+    "cuts/ep/gone.png",             # 4 not in storage
+    NOT_AN_IMAGE,                   # 5 loads, but is not an image
+    "cuts/ep/here.png",             # 6 ok
+]
+
+
+def test_zip_lists_missing_cuts(client):
+    h = signup(client)
+    put_in_storage("cuts/ep/here.png")
+    episode_id = make_episode(client, h, MIXED)
+
+    r = export(client, h, episode_id, "zip")
+    assert r.status_code == 200, r.text
+    assert r.headers["X-Missing-Cuts"] == "2,3,4,5"
+    with zipfile.ZipFile(io.BytesIO(r.content)) as zf:
+        names = sorted(zf.namelist())
+        assert zf.read("missing.txt").decode().splitlines() == ["2", "3", "4", "5"]
+    assert names == ["Ep_One_01.png", "Ep_One_06.png", "missing.txt"]
+
+

+    assert r.headers["content-type"] == "image/png"
+    assert r.headers["X-Missing-Cuts"] == "2,3,4,5"
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("fmt", ["zip", "webtoon"])

+    put_in_storage("cuts/ep/here.png")

+    "ftp://internal.example/secret.png",
+    "file:///etc/passwd",
+]
+
+DATA_URL = "data:image/png;base64," + base64.b64encode(PNG).decode()
+
+
+@pytest.fixture()
+def no_network(monkeypatch):
+    """Records (and blocks) every outgoing HTTP request or socket connection."""
+    attempts = []
+
+    def fake_request(self, method, url, *a, **kw):
+        attempts.append(url)
+        raise AssertionError(f"backend requested {url}")
+
+    def fake_connect(self, address, *a, **kw):
+        attempts.append(address)
+        raise AssertionError(f"backend connected to {address}")
+
+    monkeypatch.setattr(requests.Session, "request", fake_request)
+    monkeypatch.setattr(socket.socket, "connect", fake_connect)
+    return attempts
+
+
+def put_in_storage(key, data=PNG):
+    from app.services.storage import storage
+
+    storage.client.put_object(storage.bucket_name, key, io.BytesIO(data), len(data))
+
+
+def make_cut(client, h, image_path):
+    project = client.post("/api/v1/projects", headers=h, json={"title": "Night Bus", "genres": []}).json()
+    episode = client.post(
+        "/api/v1/episodes", headers=h, json={"title": "Ep One", "project_id": project["id"], "episode_order": 1}
+    )
+    assert episode.status_code == 200, episode.text
+    episode = episode.json()
+    cut = client.post("/api/v1/cuts", headers=h, json={"episode_id": episode["id"], "cut_order": 1})
+    assert cut.status_code == 200, cut.text
+    r = client.put(f"/api/v1/cuts/{cut.json()['id']}", headers=h, json={"image_path": image_path})
+    assert r.status_code == 200, r.text
+    return episode["id"]
+
+
+# --- the reported export -----------------------------------------------------
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("url", INTERNAL_URLS)
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("fmt", ["zip", "webtoon"])
+def test_export_never_requests_a_user_set_url(client, no_network, url, fmt):
+    h = signup(client)
+    episode_id = make_cut(client, h, url)
+    r = client.post(f"/api/v1/episodes/{episode_id}/export?format={fmt}", headers=h)
+    assert no_network == []
+    assert r.status_code == 400
+

+def test_export_zip_contains_images_from_storage_and_data_urls(client, no_network):
+    from app.core.config import settings
+
+    h = signup(client)
+    put_in_storage("cuts/abc/one.png", PNG + b"1")
+    put_in_storage("cuts/abc/two.png", PNG + b"2")
+    project = client.post("/api/v1/projects", headers=h, json={"title": "Night Bus", "genres": []}).json()
+    episode = client.post(
+        "/api/v1/episodes", headers=h, json={"title": "Ep", "project_id": project["id"], "episode_order": 1}
+    ).json()
+    paths = ["cuts/abc/one.png", f"{settings.STORAGE_HOST}/cuts/abc/two.png", DATA_URL, "http://10.0.0.1/x.png"]
+    for i, path in enumerate(paths, start=1):
+        cut = client.post(
+            "/api/v1/cuts", headers=h, json={"episode_id": episode["id"], "cut_order": i, "image_path": path}
+        )
+        assert cut.status_code == 200, cut.text
+
+    r = client.post(f"/api/v1/episodes/{episode['id']}/export?format=zip", headers=h)
+    assert r.status_code == 200, r.text
+    assert no_network == []
+    with zipfile.ZipFile(io.BytesIO(r.content)) as zf:
+        contents = sorted(zf.read(n) for n in zf.namelist() if n != "missing.txt")
+        assert zf.read("missing.txt") == b"4\n"
+    assert contents == sorted([PNG + b"1", PNG + b"2", PNG])
+
+
+def test_export_webtoon_works_with_storage_image(client, no_network):
+    h = signup(client)
+    put_in_storage("cuts/abc/strip.png")

+    assert r.status_code == 200, r.text

+/**
+ * Reads the cut numbers an episode export left out from its
+ * `X-Missing-Cuts` response header ("2,5,7"). Returns [] when nothing is missing.
+ */
+export function getMissingCuts(headers: Record<string, unknown> | undefined | null): number[] {
+  const raw = headers?.['x-missing-cuts'];
+  if (typeof raw !== 'string' || !raw.trim()) return [];
+  return raw
+    .split(',')
+    .map((part) => Number.parseInt(part.trim(), 10))
+    .filter((n) => Number.isFinite(n));
+}
